_doc: Tuning for the Drift campaign (scripts/space/drift.gd makes the map, campaign.gd runs it, docs/CONTENT.md section 8). map: nodes = how many in all (fixed places included), size = the region in px, margin = how close to the edge a random node may sit, min_spacing = least distance between two nodes, lane_third and lane_fourth = chance a node asks for a 3rd and a 4th lane (all ask for 2), lane_length = longest lane made for fun (connecting lanes may be longer), clearance = how near a lane may pass another node, clan_trader = chance a trader node is a Scrapper one (Ma's collectors take payments there). node_weights: the type of every non-fixed node is rolled by these. types: label, colour and glyph the map draws. places: the fixed nodes (pos in px; jitter = seeded wobble; faction = who runs it; hidden_until = a flag that must be set before the node shows; start = where the campaign begins). fuel: the item `fuel` costs `price` credits at stations (traders asking `trader_multiplier` times that), a drift jump costs `drift_hull` hull integrity. A normal jump takes 1 fuel times the thrust-weighted mean `fuel_mult` of the powered engines (campaign.gd jump_cost; the fraction is kept and paid in whole fuel). debt: Ma Gantry's loan (total owed, payment due every `every` jumps; `kettle` is the unique she gives when it is paid off). danger: jumps at which the enemy tier goes up. enemies: ship designs by kind and tier (paths; only the Pirate Raider exists so far, add designs here as they land). loot: after a won fight, credits and scrap ranges (times the tier) and the chance of one of the enemy's components. prices: hull repair per point, the fraction of value paid when selling, the recruit price, how many recruits a station offers. values: what things are worth (sale = half): per material rarity, per component tier, unique parts, and per item kind. stations: the menu of each place (services: fuel, sell, stock, debt, repair, recruit; stock = id -> price; recruit = species -> weight; faction decides refusal and discounts). Engine prices (engine wave 1, nothing of tier 4 or 5 is ever sold): the Mk1 price of the part's line (Kickjet 90, Concord Thruster 120, Ion Drive 300) times the part value of its tier over that of tier 1 (values.tier: 40, 90, 160), rounded to 10; Strafe Jets cost half of the Concord Thruster of their tier (half the recipe), a Long-Burn Drive the same as one. `clan_trader` is the menu of a Scrapper trader node.
